detail.longDescription: A few months into our internal pilot, the Sidekick team noticed that most of what reached them was bug reports. Someone started a channel just for wins, a place where people could post what Sidekick had done for them. It filled up faster than anyone expected. We read through it, along with the pilot feedback threads and our own team channels, and picked five stories that made us stop scrolling.
